dedupe_keys.name: energyplustofmu export energyplus as a functional mock up unit

description: EnergyPlusToFMU is a Python software package from LBNL's Simulation Research Group that exports the EnergyPlus building simulation program, version 8.0 or higher, as a Functional Mock-up Unit (FMU) for co-simulation under the Functional Mock-up Interface (FMI) standard versions 1.0 and 2.0. The FMU can then be imported into any simulation program that supports FMI co-simulation, so that, for example, a building envelope modelled in EnergyPlus can be linked with an HVAC system model developed in a Modelica environment such as Dymola. The site has a user guide, downloads, release notes, development notes and a help page, and support is through an open Google group. Coverage: generic. Access: free download; version 3.1.0 was released on 25 January 2021. Licence: an open-source licence linked from the user guide; copyright 2013-2021 The Regents of the University of California through LBNL. Caveats: no release since 2021 appears on the page, so compatibility with current EnergyPlus versions should be checked. Simulation uses: co-simulation of building envelopes with detailed HVAC and control models, control testing and digital twin workflows. Related records: EnergyPlus, the BCVTB, Dymola, OpenModelica and HELICS.
